policy.categories: Deny as a case-insensitive WHOLE-WORD or whole-phrase match inside any Vale player-facing name, title, item, ability, map, objective, mode or queue name (CONTRACT section 3.4).
policy.exact_only: Ordinary English words that some reference game uses as a proper name. Deny ONLY when an entire Vale name equals the entry after normalization; never as a word inside a longer name.
policy.normalize: Both sides: NFKD, strip diacritics, curly to straight apostrophe, lowercase, collapse spaces. Run a second pass with all non-alphanumerics removed (catches Kaisa vs Kai'Sa). For exact_only, also drop a leading "the " from both sides.
